source: 1968 Chevrolet Chassis Service Manual, Heater and Air Conditioning, p.1A-39

procedures.title: Receiver-dehydrator: replace
steps: Purge the refrigerant from the system.
Disconnect the inlet and outlet lines and cap or tape them at once.
Remove the screws holding the receiver-dehydrator to the condenser bracket and take it out.
Put the new unit in place and fit its attaching screws; keep it capped until the moment of installation.
Connect the inlet and outlet lines with new O-rings coated with clean refrigeration oil and torque to 13 ft. lbs.
Add 1 fluid oz. of refrigeration oil, then evacuate, charge and check the system.
notes: See figure 43/45 in the manual; figure 44 shows other models.

procedures.title: Sight glass: replace
notes: A damaged sight glass is replaced with a service unit containing glass, seal and retainer (see figure 46 in the manual).
